The Gradient Difference update to remove all data for donor V32P-DL000539 completed successfully in approximately 0.027 seconds, affecting 6 records.

Model performance on the retained test set remained virtually unchanged, with Balanced Accuracy and F1 score holding steady at 0.6304 and 0.2446, respectively. Minor fluctuations were observed in other metrics, such as a negligible increase in PR-AUC and a slight decrease in AUROC.

Regarding the forget set, the mean probability of positive predictions increased slightly from 0.3370 to 0.3379, while the positive prediction rate remained at 0.0. The mean Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) for the forget set also saw a small increase.

Would you like to proceed with another update or analyze these metrics further?
